patterns.note: Feature sections consistently use an asymmetrical two-column layout, pairing descriptive text on one side with a code snippet or visual example on the other, often alternating sides.
A monospaced font is prominently used for major headings and all code snippets, creating a strong technical and developer-focused aesthetic, contrasting with a clean sans-serif for body text.
The design uses a minimalist palette of white and dark greys for background and text, punctuated by a distinct red for calls-to-action and key highlights.
No scroll-triggered motion; content simply scrolls into and out of view without animations or sticky elements.
Numbered feature sections (01, 02, 03, 04) provide a clear, sequential narrative, each following a consistent structure of a large number, heading, body text, and a code example.

technique_notes: The site design relies on a static scroll experience where content blocks simply move with the page scroll, without any reveal animations, parallax effects, or sticky elements. The visual hierarchy is established through static layout and typography.
Content blocks, particularly code snippets, are visually framed with subtle borders and shadows to mimic a 'notebook' or 'code editor' interface, enhancing the developer-centric theme.
Calls-to-action are highlighted using a vibrant red color and often include a small arrow icon, providing clear visual cues for interaction.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold monospaced headings (~2-3x body) with a clear sans-serif body text, and an oversized monospaced hero heading (~4x body) for impact.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, consistent rounding on interactive elements and content containers like code blocks, contributing to a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections for readability, and a more compact, structured layout within code blocks and feature descriptions.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its strong, consistent developer-centric aesthetic, achieved through the prominent use of monospaced typography for headings and code, combined with a visual metaphor of a typewriter and notebook-style code snippets. This creates a unique blend of retro charm and modern technical focus.
